pages.text: $(o)A worm longer than a ship, nesting under the dunes. The sand ripples before it strikes.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It dives and bursts up under whoever stands still. Keep moving, and hit it hard each time it surfaces.$(br2)Its spit poisons. Bring milk or a cure.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Dune Fang$() counts for the quest book.
